#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string z;
    cin >> z;
    int ans[2] = {0, 0};
    int k = 0; // 0 = outside parentheses, 1 = inside
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        char c = z[i];
        if (c == '_') {
            if (k == 0) {
                if (count > ans[0])
                    ans[0] = count;
            } else {
                if (count > 0)
                    ans[1]++;
            }
            count = 0;
        } else if (c == '(') {
            if (k == 0) {
                if (count > ans[0])
                    ans[0] = count;
            }
            k = 1;
            count = 0;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            if (k == 1) {
                if (count > 0)
                    ans[1]++;
            }
            k = 0;
            count = 0;
        } else {
            count++;
        }
    }
    if (k == 0 && count > ans[0])
        ans[0] = count;
    cout << ans[0] << " " << ans[1] << endl;
    return 0;
}
